calls.title: Discord & GrowthBook
calls.summary: In this sales call with Discord (represented by Jennifer Richardson and Nathaniel Bennett) and GrowthBook (Ryan McGurk and Christian Liebenow), the team discussed GrowthBook's self-hosted experimentation platform, which Discord has used extensively with over 500 users. Pain points included a missed renewal, backdated billing from August to December, and strict budget constraints. calls.title: Discord + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Christian Liebenow (GrowthBook) presented a two-year renewal proposal to Jennifer Richardson and Nate B (Discord), addressing Discord’s pain points around payment flexibility, a $101k budget cap, and back-pay discounting. Key discussion centered on per-seat pricing (currently ~$405/user) and the need to keep the total deal under $500k to avoid CFO approval. Next steps: Christian will share slides, Discord will explore reducing user count to lower year-two costs, and both parties will reconvene next week.
